cooks.note: Cooked in the past year; mentioned in my Substack.

ingredients:
1 small overripe banana, mashed (1/4 cup)
1/2 cup vegetable oil or melted butter
1 cup light brown sugar, packed
1 egg yolk
1 tsp vanilla extract
1 1/3 cups all-purpose flour
1/2 tsp baking soda
2 tsp ground cinnamon
1/2 tsp salt
2/3 cup chocolate chips
steps:
Mix the butter (or oil), brown sugar and mashed banana in a large bowl.
Mix in the egg yolk and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, salt, baking soda and cinnamon until no streaks remain.
Fold in the chocolate chips. Cover and rest about 15 min while the oven heats to 350°F.
Scoop 1 oz balls onto a parchment-lined sheet, 2 inches apart. The dough will be a little wet.
Bake 10 to 11 min, until the edges are set and the middles still look underbaked. Cool before eating.
title: Banana Bread Chocolate Chip Cookies

cooks.note: Cooked in the past year; mentioned in my Substack.

ingredients:
4 cod fillets (6 oz each)
3 tbsp butter, softened
1 tbsp olive oil
3 garlic cloves, minced
2 tbsp finely chopped parsley (or chives, thyme)
1/2 tsp paprika
1 lemon, thinly sliced
Kosher salt and black pepper
steps:
Heat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Pat the cod very dry and put it in a baking dish.
Mix the butter, olive oil, garlic, parsley, paprika, salt and pepper.
Spread the butter mixture over each fillet.
Tuck lemon slices under and on top of the fish.
Bake 13 to 15 min until opaque and flaky. Spoon the pan juices over before serving.
title: Garlic Herb Baked Cod

cooks.note: Cooked in the past year; mentioned in my Substack.

ingredients:
Meatballs:
1 lb ground chicken
1/3 cup almond flour (or 1/4 cup finely chopped walnuts or pecans)
1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley
2 tsp chopped fresh dill
3 garlic cloves, minced
1/4 cup crumbled feta
1/2 tbsp onion powder (or finely chopped scallion or red onion)
2 tsp dried oregano
1 tsp ground cumin
1/2 tsp salt
1/2 tsp cracked pepper
Zest of 1 lemon
1 tbsp olive oil, for searing
Lemon orzo:
1 cup orzo
2 cups chicken broth
Juice of 1 lemon
1 tbsp olive oil
1/3 cup crumbled feta
Chopped parsley, to garnish
Salt to taste
steps:
Gently mix all the meatball ingredients (except the oil) and roll into 1 1/2 to 2 inch balls. Sprinkle with a pinch of salt.
Heat the oil in a skillet over medium. Sear the meatballs 3 to 4 min until browned, flip, then cover and cook 5 to 6 min until done. Don't overcook. Set aside.
In the same skillet, bring the broth to a boil, scraping up the browned bits. Add the orzo and cook 8 to 10 min until tender. Drain extra broth if needed.
Stir in the lemon juice, olive oil and feta.
Serve the meatballs over the orzo with parsley and extra feta. Tzatziki on the side is good.
Oven option: bake 1 inch meatballs at 400°F for 15 to 18 min, broiling the last 2 to 3 min.
title: Greek Chicken Meatballs with Lemon Orzo

changes: Rotisserie chicken instead of roasting it.
ingredients:
Lemon-herb vinaigrette:
1 large lemon, juiced (about 3 tbsp) and zested
1/4 cup thinly sliced red onion
1/3 cup extra-virgin olive oil
2 large garlic cloves, grated
1 tsp dried oregano
1/2 tsp kosher salt
1/4 tsp black pepper
Salad:
1 lb chicken breasts or thighs (I use rotisserie chicken)
8 oz sturdy pasta (rotini, penne, farfalle)
1 small English cucumber, chopped
1 medium red bell pepper, chopped
1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved
1/3 cup Kalamata olives, halved
1/2 cup crumbled feta
1/4 cup chopped fresh parsley
steps:
Soak the sliced onion in the lemon juice in a large bowl for 10 min. Whisk in the zest, olive oil, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper.
If roasting chicken: toss it with 2 tbsp of the vinaigrette and roast at 400°F (200°C) for 18 to 22 min, to 165°F. Rest 5 min, then chop. (Skip with rotisserie chicken.)
Boil the pasta in well-salted water until al dente. Drain, rinse under cold water, and shake off as much water as you can.
Add the pasta, chicken, cucumber, pepper, tomatoes, olives, feta and parsley to the bowl with the vinaigrette. Toss well.
Divide into 4 containers. Keeps 4 days in the fridge; let sit 15 min before eating.

title: Greek Yogurt Dressing

cooks.note: Cooked in the past year; mentioned in my Substack.

ingredients:
10 eggs (yolks only)
1 can (14 oz) condensed milk
1 cup fresh or evaporated milk
1 cup granulated sugar
1 tsp vanilla extract
steps:
Separate the eggs; use only the yolks. Beat the yolks in a big bowl.
Mix in the condensed milk, then the milk and vanilla.
Melt the sugar in the mold (llanera or small round pans) over low heat until it turns into a light brown caramel. Spread it evenly over the bottom.
Wait 5 min, then pour in the yolk mixture and cover with foil.
Steam 30 to 35 min.
Cool, then refrigerate before serving.
title: Leche Flan

cooks.note: Cooked in the past year; mentioned in my Substack.

ingredients:
Spice blend:
1 tsp kosher salt
1 tsp turmeric
1 tsp smoked paprika
1/2 tsp black pepper
1/4 tsp cayenne
Chicken:
1 1/2 lb boneless, skinless chicken thighs
2 tbsp olive oil
Orzo:
1 large shallot, halved and thinly sliced
3 garlic cloves, minced
1/2 tsp red pepper flakes
1 tsp Dijon
1/2 cup dry white wine
1 cup orzo
2 cups low-sodium chicken broth
Zest of 1/2 lemon
2 tbsp lemon juice
1/2 tsp kosher salt
1 tbsp chopped fresh oregano, plus more to serve
1 tbsp chopped fresh parsley
3/4 cup crumbled feta, divided
Lemon wedges, to serve
steps:
Heat the oven to 375°F.
Mix the salt, turmeric, smoked paprika, pepper and cayenne.
Pat the chicken dry and season both sides with the spice mix. Heat the oil in a deep oven-safe skillet over medium-high and brown the chicken, about 3 min per side, in batches. Set aside.
Lower to medium. Add the shallot, garlic and pepper flakes and cook 2 min. Add the Dijon and wine, scrape up the browned bits, and reduce by half.
Stir in the orzo, broth, lemon zest and juice, salt, oregano, parsley and 1/2 cup feta. Nestle in the chicken and its juices. Bake about 15 min, until the orzo is almost done.
Top with the remaining 1/4 cup feta and bake about 5 min more.
Garnish with oregano and serve with lemon wedges.
title: Creamy One-Pot Lemon Feta Chicken with Orzo

cooks.note: Cooked in the past year; mentioned in my Substack.

ingredients:
2 cans (15 oz) white beans, drained and rinsed
1/2 cup chopped fresh herbs (parsley, basil, dill, mint...)
2 roasted red peppers, finely diced
1/3 cup finely diced shallot
2 garlic cloves, minced
1/2 cup extra-virgin olive oil
1 lemon, zested and juiced (about 3 tbsp juice)
1/2 tsp kosher salt
1/4 tsp red pepper flakes
Black pepper
steps:
Stir everything together in a large bowl.
Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours, ideally overnight. Stir before serving.
Keeps 3 to 4 days in the fridge. Good on toast, salads, or as a side.
title: Marinated White Beans

cooks.note: Very easy, delicious. Served with goat cheese and heirloom tomato toasts.

ingredients:
2 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil
1 medium yellow onion, diced
2 medium carrots, chopped
2 celery ribs, thinly sliced
1 tsp sea salt, plus more
Black pepper
3 garlic cloves, grated
1 can (28 oz) diced tomatoes
1 1/2 cups cooked white or kidney beans
1 cup chopped green beans
4 cups vegetable broth
2 bay leaves
1 tsp dried oregano
1 tsp dried thyme
3/4 cup small pasta
1/2 cup chopped parsley
Red pepper flakes
Grated Parmesan, for serving
steps:
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium. Add the onion, carrots, celery, salt and pepper and cook 8 min, until starting to soften.
Add the garlic, tomatoes, beans, green beans, broth, bay leaves, oregano and thyme. Cover and simmer 20 min.
Stir in the pasta and cook uncovered 10 min, until done.
Season to taste. Serve with parsley, pepper flakes and Parmesan.
title: Minestrone Soup

cooks.note: Variation: garlic, carrots, celery, zucchini and red bell pepper, with soy sauce and sesame oil instead of the miso mixture, plus scrambled eggs.

ingredients:
Vegetables:
1 carrot, diced
1 celery stalk, diced
1/2 red bell pepper, diced
1/2 zucchini, diced
Chard, stems chopped small, leaves roughly chopped
Rice and egg:
Cooked rice
1 egg
Olive oil
Miso sauce:
1 tbsp miso
1 tbsp mirin
1 tsp rice vinegar
Pinch of garlic powder
Topping:
About 1/3 cup Greek yogurt
Small dab of miso
Splash of rice vinegar
Raw heirloom tomato, chopped
Black pepper
steps:
Prep:
Dice the carrot, celery, pepper and zucchini. Keep the chopped chard stems with the carrots; set the leaves aside.
Mix the miso, mirin, rice vinegar and garlic powder.
Cook:
Heat olive oil over medium-high. Cook the carrot, celery and chard stems 3 to 4 min.
Add the pepper and zucchini and cook 2 min more.
Add the rice, press it flat, and leave it 2 min to crisp, then stir.
Push everything to one side, add a few drops of oil, crack in the egg, break the yolk and scramble until set (about 1 min). Stir it into the rice.
Pour in the miso mixture and toss. Add the chard leaves and cook until wilted.
Make sure it's steaming hot, then take it off the heat.
Top with chopped heirloom tomato, black pepper, and the yogurt-miso topping.
title: Miso Veggie Fried Rice with Egg

cooks.note: Cooked in the past year; mentioned in my Substack.

ingredients:
1 1/2 lb pork belly, cubed
3/4 cup pineapple juice
8 garlic cloves, crushed
3 tbsp soy sauce
5 tbsp white vinegar
4 tsp fish sauce
3 dried bay leaves
1/2 tsp cracked peppercorns
2 tbsp cooking oil
steps:
Marinate the pork in the pineapple juice for at least 3 hours.
Lift the pork out of the marinade; keep the marinade.
Heat the oil and sauté the garlic until it starts to brown.
Add the pork and sauté until the outside turns light brown.
Add the soy sauce, bay leaves and peppercorns and cook 2 min.
Add the vinegar and the leftover marinade. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low until the pork is tender.
Uncover, add the fish sauce, and cook on medium until the sauce fully evaporates.
Serve with warm rice.
title: Nagmamantikang Pork Adobo

cooks.note: Served with my pesto and Parmesan shavings.
Possibly a second batch. Served with the Spinach Artichoke White Bean Soup.

ingredients:
4 cups (512 g) all-purpose or bread flour
2 to 3 tsp (10 to 15 g) kosher salt
2 tsp (8 g) instant yeast
2 cups (455 g) lukewarm water (1/2 cup boiling + 1 1/2 cups cold)
Butter, for greasing
4 tbsp olive oil, divided
Flaky sea salt
1 to 2 tsp rosemary leaves (optional)
steps:
Whisk the flour, salt and yeast in a large bowl. Add the water and stir with a spatula into a sticky dough.
Optional: rest 30 min, then stretch and fold 8 to 10 times with a wet hand until smooth.
Rub the dough with olive oil, cover tightly, and refrigerate at least 12 hours, up to 3 days.
Grease two 8 or 9 inch pie plates or one 9×13 pan with butter. Add 1 tbsp oil per pie plate (2 tbsp for a 9×13).
Deflate the dough with two forks, split in two (or not, for a 9×13), and roll in the oil. Rest uncovered 3 to 4 hours at room temp.
Heat the oven to 425°F. Top with rosemary, drizzle 1 tbsp oil per round (2 for 9×13), dimple deeply with oiled fingers, and sprinkle with flaky salt.
Bake 25 to 30 min until golden underneath. Cool 10 min on a rack before cutting.
Store airtight up to 3 days or freeze up to 3 months. Reheat at 350°F for 15 min.

title: Poppy Seed Dressing

changes: Heirloom tomatoes to make up for not enough cherry tomatoes.

cooks.note: Didn't have enough cherry tomatoes, so I used heirloom tomatoes I had on hand.

ingredients:
Roasted vegetables:
2 medium zucchini (1 lb), cut into half moons
1 small eggplant (1 lb), diced into 1 inch cubes
1 small red onion, thickly sliced
3 tbsp olive oil, divided
Salt and black pepper
1 lb cherry or grape tomatoes
Garlic balsamic pasta:
1 lb pasta (mezze rigatoni)
4 tbsp salted butter
5 large garlic cloves, pressed or minced
1/2 tsp red pepper flakes
2 tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 oz grated Parmesan, plus more to serve
1/3 cup finely chopped fresh basil, plus more to serve
steps:
Heat the oven to 425°F and line a large baking sheet with parchment. Bring a big pot of well-salted water to a boil.
Toss the zucchini, eggplant and onion with 2 tbsp oil, spread on the sheet, season well, and roast 15 min.
Toss the tomatoes with the last 1 tbsp oil, salt and pepper. Add them to the sheet and roast 15 min more.
When the tomatoes go in, cook the pasta until just al dente.
Melt the butter in a large nonstick pan over medium-high until it starts to foam. Add the garlic and pepper flakes and cook 1 min while the butter browns. Turn off the heat and stir in the balsamic.
Move the pasta straight into the sauce and toss. Add the Parmesan and a splash of pasta water as needed until glossy.
Gently fold in the roasted vegetables and basil.
Serve right away with extra basil, Parmesan and black pepper.
title: Roasted Vegetable Pasta

cooks.note: Cooked in the past year; mentioned in my Substack.

ingredients:
1 block (14 oz) firm or extra-firm tofu, drained
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp mirin
1 tsp toasted sesame oil
3/4 tsp gochugaru (or other mild red pepper flakes)
1 scallion
2 tbsp grapeseed or vegetable oil, divided
Kosher salt
1 small garlic clove, finely chopped
1 tsp finely chopped peeled ginger
Toasted sesame seeds and cooked rice, for serving
steps:
Wrap the tofu in a towel, weigh it down, and let it sit 10 min. Halve lengthwise, then cut crosswise into 6 to make 12 squares.
Whisk the soy sauce, mirin, sesame oil, gochugaru and 3 tbsp water. Set aside.
Slice the dark green scallion top and set aside. Thinly slice the white and pale green parts.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-high. Add the tofu in one layer, salt lightly, and cook undisturbed until golden, about 5 min per side. Move to a plate; keep the skillet.
Heat the other 1 tbsp oil over medium. Cook the scallion whites, garlic and ginger about 1 min, until soft but not browned.
Return the tofu, pour in the sauce, and bring to a simmer. Lower to medium-low and cook about 4 min, turning and spooning sauce over, until the sauce reduces by half.
Plate the tofu, spoon the sauce over, and top with sesame seeds and scallion greens. Serve with rice.
title: Spicy Braised Tofu

ingredients:
1 bulb garlic
Avocado oil
2 leeks, green tops removed
1 yellow onion, diced
1/2 cup raw cashews
5 oz fresh spinach
1 jar (15 oz) quartered marinated artichoke hearts, drained and patted dry
2 tbsp nutritional yeast
1 tsp ground coriander
1/2 tsp red pepper flakes (optional)
1 can (15 oz) cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
4 cups vegetable broth
2 bay leaves
10 thyme sprigs
1 tsp yellow miso
Kosher salt
Toasted bread and olive oil, for serving
steps:
Roast the garlic: slice the top off, drizzle with 2 tsp oil and salt, wrap in foil, and roast at 400°F for 40 to 45 min. Cool. (Shortcut: sauté 6 to 8 minced cloves with the leeks instead.)
Slice the leeks lengthwise, rinse out the grit, pat dry and slice thin. Dice the onion.
Cover the cashews with boiling water for 10 min, then drain.
Cover the spinach with boiling water for 2 min, rinse cold, and squeeze dry.
Heat 2 tbsp oil in a Dutch oven over medium-low. Sear the artichokes undisturbed 5 to 6 min until browned. Set aside.
Add the leeks and a pinch of salt and cook 10 min until golden. Add the onion and cook 5 min.
Stir in the nutritional yeast, coriander and pepper flakes for 2 to 3 min.
Add the beans, broth, bay leaves and thyme. Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer 20 min.
Blend the cashews, roasted garlic, miso and 1 cup water until smooth. Add the spinach and blend until mostly smooth.
Remove the bay leaves and thyme. Stir in the artichokes and spinach cream, take off the heat, and salt to taste.
title: Spinach Artichoke White Bean Soup

changes: Rotisserie chicken, walnuts instead of almonds, and my own Poppy Seed Dressing.
ingredients:
Salad:
2 bone-in, skin-on chicken breasts (I use rotisserie chicken)
1 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp kosher salt, 1/4 tsp pepper (for roasting)
5 oz baby spinach
1 cup strawberries, hulled and quartered
1/4 cup goat cheese, crumbled
1/4 cup sliced almonds (I use walnuts)
Dressing:
My Poppy Seed Dressing (see its card), or the original: 1/2 cup olive oil, 2 tbsp champagne vinegar, 2 tbsp lemon juice, 1 tbsp poppy seeds, 1/2 tsp Dijon, 1 tsp kosher salt, 1/4 tsp pepper
steps:
Shake the dressing ingredients together in a jar.
If roasting chicken: pat dry, rub with oil, salt and pepper, and roast at 450°F (230°C) for about 45 min, to 165°F. Rest 5 to 10 min. (Skip with rotisserie chicken.)
Put the spinach in a large bowl and add the strawberries, goat cheese and nuts.
Slice the chicken into strips about 1/2 inch thick and add to the salad.
Drizzle with dressing, toss, and serve with extra dressing on the side.
title: Strawberry Chicken Salad with Spinach

ingredients:
1 medium sweet potato, diced into 1 cm cubes
Chard, stems chopped small, leaves roughly chopped (kept separate)
Olive oil
Salt
Pinch of cumin
2 eggs
Grated manchego
Sliced avocado
Black pepper
steps:
Heat olive oil over medium-high. Add the sweet potato, salt and cumin. Cover and cook 8 to 10 min, stirring now and then, until tender and browned in spots.
Add the chard stems and cook 2 min, then add the leaves and cook until wilted.
Make 2 wells and crack an egg into each. Cover and cook until fully set, 4 to 5 min.
Top with grated manchego, sliced avocado and black pepper.
title: Sweet Potato and Chard Hash with Eggs
